author: GodEmperorDoge
name: Watch
short: Preload library media or request a movie/TV download.
description: Preload existing library media, or request English movie/TV downloads through ARR with title/quality selection and owner-managed individual permissions.
install_msg: Set the API token with the PRELOAD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable or `[p]set api media_preload token,<token>` (and url,<url> if it isn't http://host.containers.internal:8125).
end_user_data_statement: Stores a linked Jellyfin name and an owner-managed per-user download permission. watch unlink removes the name; Red user-data deletion removes both.
